title: Linear Fallback Queue
description: Schema for tooling/linear-queue.json — used when the Linear MCP server is unavailable. See tooling/README.md.

id.description: Locally unique queue item id, e.g. q-2026-06-09-001

action.description: Linear MCP action this item replays when drained.

payload.description: Arguments for the Linear MCP call. Shape depends on action; minimally include team key + the resource fields.

queuedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the item was queued.

queuedBy.description: Agent session id OR human handle that queued the item, for audit.

reason.description: Why the live MCP call failed (informational).

lastError.description: Last replay error string (null if never attempted or last succeeded).
